confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from crowdsourced cost-of-living pages (MyLifeElsewhere, Expatistan, Tripbase, combien-coute.net) with mixed or undated collection periods; Expatistan's beer and wine figures are from 2021 and 2024. Restaurant anchors are rough but bounded. Mid-range meal and wine glass are the weakest food anchors. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and were not checked against live listings. July is peak season, so hotel rates may run higher than these estimates. FX: the RBA exchange-rates page snippet showed 0.6955 at 4.00 pm on 2026-10-15; I did not open the F11.1 table directly, and a third-party figure for 2026-10-16 could not be confirmed.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. Food and drink were anchored on Xiamen-specific aggregator figures, cross-checked against each other. Accommodation was estimated from general knowledge of Chinese second-tier coastal city budget and mid-range hotel and hostel pricing. Beer was taken as a local price relationship to the restaurant-meal anchor, and the wine glass was taken from the bottle price relationship, as described in the notes.
